module: Existing 2.8-inch TFT SPI 240x320 / ILI9341 screen assembly with existing soldered wires and Dupont connectors
source: Owner-reported manual measurements in chat; instrument not restated for this batch. Do not substitute nominal catalog dimensions.
status: partial physical survey; several references still to be clarified

coordinate_reference.view: Confirmed by owner 2026-11-12: looking at BACK of display PCB, with SD card slot and header facing viewer, HEADER ON RIGHT.
coordinate_reference.origin: Bottom-left corner of rectangular PCB in this rear-side view.
coordinate_reference.axes: X right from non-header (left) short edge to header (right) short edge, X range 0..86 mm; Y upward from PCB bottom long edge to top long edge, Y range 0..50 mm; board Z-axis to be aligned in assembly separately.
coordinate_reference.dimension_mapping: PCB 'length' 86 mm runs horizontally as X. PCB 'width' 50 mm runs vertically as Y in this rear view. The screen length 69.25 mm runs along X and screen width 50 mm along Y.
coordinate_reference.z: Reported total thicknesses are whole-assembly measurements, not individual protrusion heights above either PCB face.

overall_width_mm.notes: Owner: 'Screen is even with width' of PCB; glass same full width as PCB. Exact glass edge flushness and left/right offsets not independently measured.

front_to_back_thickness_with_pcb_mm.notes: Whole PCB + screen stack as stated by owner, not glass layer thickness alone.

ends_total_uncovered_pcb_mm.notes: Total uncovered PCB length across both ends; distribution along Y not measured.

reported_height_in_plane_mm.notes: In-plane vertical extent as described by owner, not thickness

left_edge_from_left_pcb_edge_mm.notes: Rear view confirmed: left non-header short PCB edge at X=0; slot X starts at 26 mm, extends rightward along 86 mm long axis.

bottom_edge_from_bottom_pcb_edge_mm.notes: Rear view confirmed: bottom long PCB edge at Y=0; slot Y starts at 31.5 mm, extends upward.

rear_view_bounds_mm.board_check: Fits within PCB X=0..86, Y=0..50. Earlier 4.5 mm overhang calculation mistakenly compared slot X to 50 mm Y extent; corrected.

total_thickness_including_pcb_screen_sd_.notes: Overall front-to-back stack; cannot deduce which side the SD slot protrudes or its sole thickness from this measurement.

wiring.connection_to_s3: Owner confirmed earlier that display and microphone connections at the S3 are directly soldered; specific screen-end joints not characterized.

dupont_wire_clearance_from_top_of_screen.notes: Owner: 'total clearance needed with current dupont connectors, 28mm from top of screen'. Direction, reference surface and whether total dimension or added allowance need confirmation; do not derive total case thickness.

checks.resolution: The user confirmed rear view with header on RIGHT: board is 86 mm across X, 50 mm across Y. Slot X=26..54.5 and Y=31.5..48.1. All fit inside PCB.

pending: Confirm SD slot sits on rear face and height clearance in Z; measured 8.3 mm overall stack.
Confirm header first pin's approximate 1.9 mm edge reference if exact X coordinate required.
Locate screen glass along PCB length: board-end to glass near edge, and visible lit area bounds.
Confirm 28 mm Dupont clearance reference surface/direction.
Measure display rear connector/body and solder protrusions relative to PCB rear face.
Confirm SD slot side/height relative to front glass for stacking.
Count header pins, identify pitch and note whether pins/plastic project front or rear.
verbatim_trailing_fragment: Owner message ends with isolated '3'; no numeric measurement is inferred from that fragment.

mounting_holes.positioning_reference: Rear view confirmed: header on right (X=86), non-header end on left (X=0), bottom Y=0, top Y=50. Each near-wall measurement remains from physical PCB edge to nearest hole rim, not center.

edge_to_hole_near_wall_mm.notes: From non-header short-end edge into PCB to nearest hole rim; user described as 'to the top of the hole'

long_side_edge_to_hole_near_wall_mm.notes: Both non-header corners, nominally symmetric; user did not give separate left/right values

edge_to_hole_near_wall_mm.notes: From header-side short end into PCB; owner says inset to clear header

long_side_edge_to_hole_near_wall_mm.notes: Near side of hole; both header-end corners provisionally assumed symmetric

mounting_holes.notes: Coordinates derived using nominal symmetric corner offsets, after owner confirmed rear view and header on right. Separate near-wall measurements for each left/right/top/bottom hole are not independently reported; retain that qualification for precision fit.

header.placement: Header row along the RIGHT short edge (X near 86) in confirmed rear view, spanning much of the PCB's Y=0..50 mm height.

plastic_body_length_mm.notes: Includes plastic header base; physical length of strip, not pin protrusion or number of pins.

plastic_body_margin_from_one_50mm_side_m.notes: Reported 7.1 mm from TOP long PCB edge (Y=50), viewed from PCB rear.

plastic_body_margin_from_opposite_50mm_s.notes: Reported approximately 7.1 mm from BOTTOM long PCB edge (Y=0). With 35.5 mm body this sums to 49.7 mm, 0.3 mm below reported PCB width; use measured length and margin without forcing exact symmetry.

first_pin_center_from_top_50mm_side_mm.notes: Rear view: top long PCB edge Y=50; first header pin center approximately at Y=41.63 mm.

first_pin_center_from_header_end_mm.notes: Owner: 'approx 1.9 from the side'; now likely distance to right/header-end PCB edge X=86 but still approximate. Do not place precise pin X without confirming reference.

header.notes: Header body runs vertically on the right edge in rear view; width 2.4 mm across X and length 35.5 mm along Y. Physical pin count/pitch and Z protrusion unmeasured.

x.notes: Only if 1.9 mm is indeed from the right PCB edge to pin center
